observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: Outdoor public plaza in front of a historic building, daylight, daytime event with spectators seated on steps
observation.dancers: Multiple couples of children/youth, mixed boys and girls
observation.formation_and_space: Couples arranged in a line across the outdoor stage performing synchronized steps
observation.posture: Upright torso, relaxed knees, weight shifting between feet with lively stepping
observation.footwork: Rhythmic stepping and heel taps moving side-to-side on the upbeat
observation.arms_and_hands: Girls hold and manipulate wide skirts; boys keep hands behind back or hold hats/scarves
observation.hips_and_torso: Relatively upright and still torso, upper body facing partner or front
observation.partnering: Couples dance side-by-side or facing each other without continuous physical contact
observation.levels_jumps_turns: Standing throughout with occasional turns and ending with boys kneeling
observation.costume_and_props: Girls wear white blouses with red floral embroidery, long red tiered skirts, and hair in buns with flowers; boys wear white button-down shirts, dark pants, neckscarves, and white cowboy hats
observation.cannot_infer: Exact footwork details and precise weight distribution are obscured by wide-angle camera framing and video compression.

signature_moments.what: Couples step side to side while sweeping their arms and skirts outward rhythmically.
Couples link arms and turn in a circle together.
